limitations: Finite inherited ground/9-degree near-hit (<12m) ray suite, not all positions/high angles/bullet resistance.

Inherited wall/shelter repetition remains but new details have plausible support and purposeful connections; no uncorrected visible shoulder breaks, floating beds or black road rectangles in final inspected views.
